title: Spirituality of God
definition: The spirituality of God means that God is spirit, not limited by a physical body, location, or material form.
summary: God is spirit and must be worshiped in spirit and truth.
christFocus: Jesus reveals the invisible God and makes true worship possible through His saving work.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is spirit. He is not a creature with a physical body, nor can He be contained by a temple, image, or location. He is present and active beyond creaturely limitations.

This doctrine does not make God vague or impersonal. The living God knows, speaks, loves, judges, saves, and dwells with His people. He reveals Himself truly through His Word and supremely in Christ.

Because God is spirit, true worship is not confined to outward ritual or place. It must be offered in spirit and truth through Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often reduce God to images, locations, feelings, or visible forms. The spirituality of God matters because it calls believers to worship the unseen God according to His revealed truth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Worship God with reverence beyond what you can see or control. Let Scripture, not imagination, shape your understanding of who He is.
